main_text.l: DE JURE PROTESTAN-TIUM ORTHODOXORUM CONTRA concilium Tridentinum, & reliquas pontificiorum Romanorū syn-odos & conventus ; eo-rūmq; constitutiones atq; anathe-mata.

QUÆRITUR an jure protestan-tes rejiciant auctoritatem concilii Tridentini caeterarumq; synodorum, quae sunt ad praescriptum & sententiam pontificum Romanorū indicta? Rō. pontificii negant. Orthodoxi pro-testantes affirmant.

Affirmativam sequentibus rationibus probamus. Nam ex historia sacra cō-stat, omnes solennes conventus & synodos in populo Dei esse convo-catas non à sacerdotibus; sed à gu-bernatoribus populi (qui videlicet fuerunt professione ecclesiae membra) horum item auctoritate cultus impios atque idololatricos esse sublatos,

page.notes: The initial Q is a large woodcut letter, joined to QUÆRITUR. The ornament above the heading is not text. The line ending "sub," with "latos," on the last line reads as one word; the separate "E" on that line is doubtful and is given as a catchword with [?]. Printed spacing "conventus ;" and "eo-rūmq;" kept as printed.
